content.comment_body: Hi, I want to program a [product_name]. I don’t have the dedicated PC cable and only have a cable for another [product_name] series. Is it possible to use this cable for programming? Is the specific PC cable for [product_name] required?

Hello [user_name], Unfortunately, only the dedicated PC cable for [product_name] can be used. You cannot use cables from other [product_name] series. Alternatively, you can program the [product_name] directly using its buttons. Best regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Users highlight the importance of hardware compatibility when programming a [product_name] device. Cables for different product series are not interchangeable, so users without the dedicated PC cable face restrictions. A manual programming option using device buttons is mentioned, showing limited flexibility without the required accessory.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to program the [product_name] device with a cable from a different series, expecting accessories to be interchangeable.
